newsitem.title: USA: Biovail signs European licensing pacts.
newsitem.headline: Biovail signs European licensing pacts.

text.p: Biovail Corp International said on Tuesday it has signed licensing agreements covering Britain, Ireland and Spain for its medication Diltiazem, used to treat angina pectoris and hypertension.
The company said that the product, which is known in the United States as Tiazac, is expected to be launched in the first half of 1997 and will include all five currently available doses.
Additional European licenses are expected "in the near term," the company said in a statement.
Biovail has signed an exclusive marketing agreement for its once daily Diltiaz with DuPont Merck Pharmaceutical Co for the United Kingdom and Ireland.
DuPont Merck is a partnership formed in 1991 by DuPont Co and Merck & Co Inc.
In Spain, Laboratories Alter, a privately held Spanish conglomerate, has been appointed the exclusive licensee for Diltiazem in that country.
